name: albert-heijn-mcp
shortDescription: Shop at Albert Heijn: products, bonus deals, recipes and your shopping list.
description: Use your Albert Heijn account in your AI assistant: search products and bonus deals, plan meals from Allerhande recipes, manage your shopping list, favourites and delivery order, and look back at your orders and receipts.
longDescription:
Connect your AI assistant to your Albert Heijn account and do your grocery shopping by just asking, in Dutch, English or any other language.

- Find products, compare prices and nutrition, and filter by diet or allergens: organic, vegan, gluten-free and more.
- See this week's and next week's bonus deals, including deals on products you usually buy.
- Search Allerhande recipes, scale them to any number of servings, and put the ingredients on your shopping list in one step.
- Manage your shopping list and favourite lists, check delivery slots, and change your upcoming delivery order.
- Look back at past orders, your most-ordered products, and in-store receipts.
- Find nearby stores and today's vandaag-af deals.

Unofficial: this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Albert Heijn. It uses the same API as the AH mobile app.
